name: Immunization Fixture
remarks: Hand-authored GMF fixture for ADR-0182 (the :immunization kind): this
project's own authored data, not derived from or copied out of any real
Synthea module, so it carries no NOTICE/provenance obligation the way a
vendored module would. No vendored module carries a Vaccine state; this
fixture is the compiled producer the oracle's `immunization` root and
ehrt.sim-engine.engine-test run. One wellness visit, two Vaccine states:
the first states its series, the second does not, so the log carries
:series on exactly the first. The walk loops a year at a time until the
run's registration year (reference-birth-year + 1), so the visit is
horizon content for every DOB the persona sampler can draw. A LOOP, not
a Date Guard: the interpreter jumps time only for Age guards, and a
